project.title: iTaunted
project.description: World of Warcraft addon for social interactions and taunts.
project.longDescription: iTaunted is a World of Warcraft addon designed to enhance social gameplay with customizable taunts and interactive features for player-to-player communication.

relatedProjects.title: Express your Elf
relatedProjects.description: World of Warcraft addon for character customization and expression.
relatedProjects.longDescription: Express your Elf is a World of Warcraft addon that expands character customization options, allowing players to personalize their elven characters with unique visual enhancements and cosmetic features.

relatedProjects.title: Nurse Nancy
relatedProjects.description: World of Warcraft companion addon with utility and gameplay enhancements.
relatedProjects.longDescription: Nurse Nancy is a utility-focused World of Warcraft addon that provides helpful in-game features and quality-of-life improvements for healing and support gameplay.

relatedProjects.title: Divine Window
relatedProjects.description: World of Warcraft interface enhancement for divine and holy themes.
relatedProjects.longDescription: Divine Window enhances the World of Warcraft interface with a focus on holy and divine aesthetics, providing both visual improvements and functional enhancements for players interested in light-themed interfaces.
